moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Create person or retail customer Before this write: if the prompt lists a QuickSearch or QuickLookup actions path, GET it and create only when nothing matches. Dialog **New Person Customer** POST `createPersonCustomer`. `roleTypeId` stays `Customer` (hidden). `partyClassificationId` default `CustConsumer` (Consumer, retail). Other classes only when the user names that class: `CustWholesale` Wholesale, `CustRetailStore` (Wholesale - Retail Store, a wholesale buyer), `CustProfessional`, `CustDistributor`, `CustDistributorPref`, `CustEnterprise`, `CustBroker`, `CustEmployee` (a class, not the Employee role). fields: `firstName`, `lastName`, optional `emailAddress`, phone `countryCode`/`areaCode`/`contactNumber`, postal `address1` `unitNumber` `address2` `city` `countryGeoId` `stateProvinceGeoId` `postalCode` `postalCodeExt`. The dialog has neither field. Returns `partyId`. Link `/qapps/marble/Customer/EditCustomer?partyId=`. A company or business customer is `create-sales-account`. moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: review-accounting-reports
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: Review accounting reports
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: Income Statement Balance Sheet Recalc All; last month invoices by TimePeriod FiscalMonth
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Accounting reports Before this write: if the prompt lists a QuickSearch or QuickLookup actions path, GET it and create only when nothing matches. A sales dashboard or order and invoice summary is `order-invoice-reports`. Cash flow, ratios, and the account ledger are `ledger-accounting-reports`. `/apps/marble/Accounting/Reports/ReportList`. If empty (no per-transaction GL summary): Time Period `/apps/marble/Accounting/TimePeriod/FindTimePeriod` → current year Accounts `/apps/marble/Accounting/TimePeriod/ViewPeriodGlAccounts` **Recalc All** POST `recalculateAllAmounts` `organizationPartyId` (a write; confirm first). Income Statement: `run_service` `mantle.ledger.LedgerReportServices.run#IncomeStatement`. Balance Sheet: `run_service` `mantle.ledger.LedgerReportServices.run#BalanceSheet`. Do not GET the HTML report screens. fields: `organizationPartyId` (Internal Org), `timePeriodIdList`, `detail=true`, percents. Link `/qapps/marble/Accounting/Reports/ReportList`. # Invoiced last month GET `/apps/marble/Accounting/TimePeriod/FindTimePeriod/actions/TimePeriodList` `partyId`=activeOrgId `timePeriodTypeId`=FiscalMonth. Use the row whose `fromDate`/`thruDate` cover last month (`timePeriodId`, `isClosed`). Then GET `/apps/marble/Accounting/Invoice/FindInvoice/actions/InvoiceList` `invoiceType`=Receivable `fromPartyId`=activeOrgId `invoiceDate_from`/`invoiceDate_thru` from that period (find field `invoiceDate`), or `run_service` `mantle.ledger.LedgerReportServices.run#IncomeStatement` with `organizationPartyId`=activeOrgId and that `timePeriodIdList`. Canvas BarChart of the totals (BarChart is already on the canvas). Link `/qapps/marble/Accounting/Invoice/EditInvoice?invoiceId=`. Before finalize (`updateStatus` `InvoiceFinalized`), payment (`recordPayment`), or **Recalc All**, read `messages` on the tool result. If a message says the period is closed, repeat that warning in the confirm sentence. Do not add a tool.

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: report-builder
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: Report builder
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: SimpleReport DataDocument custom report fields conditions view export
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Report builder Before this write: if the prompt lists a QuickSearch or QuickLookup actions path, GET it and create only when nothing matches. Report Builder `/apps/marble/SimpleReport` (FindReport, EditReport, ViewReport). Custom Reports `/apps/marble/QuickViewReport`. Parent hides `moqui.*` entities. If browse shows `/apps/hm`, use that mount. GET `/apps/marble/SimpleReport/FindReport/actions/DataDocumentList` `dataDocumentId`, `documentName`, `primaryEntityName` (`DataDocumentAndUserGroup`, user's groups only). View GET `/apps/marble/SimpleReport/ViewReport/actions/DataViewList` (same form on QuickViewReport) `dataDocumentId`. Dynamic entity `DataDocument.{dataDocumentId}` is a relational view, not ElasticSearch. CSV and XLSX are on that form. Download JSON `DocumentExport.json` `fromUpdateStamp`, `thruUpdateStamp`, `prettyPrint`. If the user is not in `DataDocumentUserGroup` for that id, the screen refuses. Do not invent another path. **Create Report** POST `/apps/marble/SimpleReport/FindReport/createDataDocument` (`org.moqui.impl.EntityServices.create#DataDocument`). fields: `dataDocumentId` (match `[A-Z]\w*`, must not already be an entity name), `documentName`, `primaryEntityName` (full entity name, not `moqui.*`), `userGroupId` (one of the current user's groups). **Update** POST `EditReport/updateDataDocument`: `documentName`, `primaryEntityName`, and `userGroupId` only when the document has a single group. Fields on `EditReport/FieldList`. **Add field** POST `createDataDocumentField`: `dataDocumentId`, `fieldPath` (primary field, or relationship names joined with `:`, e.g. `items:product:productName`). Optional `fieldNameAlias` (stored camel case; required when two paths would share a name), `functionName` one of `min` `max` `sum` `avg` `count` `count-distinct` `upper` `lower`. Update POST `updateDataDocumentField` (`fieldSeqId`). Delete POST `deleteDataDocumentField`. **Add Condition** POST `createDataDocumentCondition`. Operators: `equals` `not-equals` `less` `greater` `less-equals` `greater-equals` `in` `not-in` `between` `not-between` `like` `not-like` `is-null` `is-not-null`. The condition field is an alias of a field already on the document. This screen ignores `postQuery`. `indexName` is for search indexing. Viewing the report does not query ElasticSearch. Link `/qapps/marble/SimpleReport/EditReport?dataDocumentId=` or `/qapps/marble/QuickViewReport?dataDocumentId=`. A saved DataDocument is not a substitute for Accounting/Reports. Those screens already exist.

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Order and invoice reports Read only. No sim. No confirm. GL income statement and balance sheet: `review-accounting-reports`. Inventory on hand: `inventory-asset-reports`. # Sales Summary (ElasticSearch) Screen `/apps/marble/Accounting/Reports/SalesSummary`. Link `/qapps/marble/Accounting/Reports/SalesSummary`. For a dashboard, summary, trend, or how-are-sales question, `run_service` the four services below. Do not GET the screen to scrape charts. Stat cards and charts are templates over those results. If the tool message says ElasticSearch is not available or no ElasticClient, say that and use the relational reports below. Summary Options, pass the same values into the services. `interval`: `d` day, `w` week, `M` month, `q` quarter, `y` year. Screen defaults `interval=w` and `intervalCount=13`. Services default `interval=M`, so a call that should match the screen must pass `w`. `thruDate` defaults to today. `maPeriods` default `0` (moving-average lookback; `0` disables it). Filters: `vendorPartyIds` (role `OrgInternal`), `productStoreIds`, `customerClassificationIds` (`PcltCustomer`), `customerPartyIds`, `productIds` (finished inventory `AsClsInventoryFin`). Empty vendor means every vendor in the index. Set `vendorPartyIds` to `activeOrgId` when the user means this company. The screen passes `vendorPartyIds` as invoice `fromPartyIds` and `customerPartyIds` as `toPartyIds`. Services are `mantle.sales.SalesReportServices`, cluster `default`, index name default `mantle_sales` (the real index is the DataDocument index). `get#SalesOrderSummary` reads `MantleSalesOrderItem` on `placedDate`. Status filter on both `partStatusId` and `statusId`: `OrderPlaced` `OrderProcessing` `OrderApproved` `OrderSent` `OrderCompleted` `OrderHold`. Date histogram, newest bucket first, then the list is reversed. Aggregations: cardinality of `orderId`; sum of `itemSaleTotal`; `ItemProduct` (`itemTypeEnumId=ItemProduct`) sums `itemSaleTotal`, `issuances.issuedSaleTotal`, `issuances.issuedCostTotal`, `orderQuantity`; discount filter sums `itemSaleTotal` for `ItemDiscount` `ItemPromptDiscount` `ItemCouponCredit` `ItemPromoDiscount` `ItemFreeFills` `ItemSlottingFees` `ItemAdjAdvertising` `ItemAdjJointAdv`; new customers are `isNewCustomer=Y` and a cardinality of `orderId`. `netSales` is product sales plus the discount total (discount item amounts are negative). `discountPercent` is `-discountTotal/productSaleTotal`. `costPercent` is issued cost over issued sales. `newCustomerPercent` is new-customer orders over order count. `get#SalesInvoiceSummary` reads `MantleSalesInvoice` and `MantleSalesInvoiceItem` on `invoiceDate`. Statuses: `InvoiceFinalized` `InvoiceSent` `InvoiceAcked` `InvoicePmtRecvd` (not in process). Header sums: `invoiceTotal`, `appliedPaymentsTotal` (paid), `prePaymentsTotal`. Item side: cardinality of `invoiceId`, `ItemProduct` sums of `itemSaleTotal`, issued sale, issued cost, and `quantity`, plus the same discount types. `paidPercent` is payments applied over `invoiceTotal`. `prePaidPercent` is prepayments over `invoiceTotal`. `get#SalesTopProduct` is one period, `poffset=-1` (the previous period, not the current one). Screen passes `topLimit=15` (service default `10`). Terms on `productId`. Fields: `totalSales`, `totalQuantity`, `productIssuedTotal`, `productCostTotal`, `costPercent`. Margin percent is `1 - costPercent`. `get#InvoicesByCustomerClass` is that same previous period. Terms on `customerClassId`. Header totals from `MantleSalesInvoice`, item totals from `MantleSalesInvoiceItem`. Out maps `ordersThis` `ordersLast` `ordersPrior` `ordersAverage` and the invoice twins. This is the current open period and is excluded from Prior Total and Prior Average. Last is the previous complete period. Prior is the one before that. The summary lists end with two rows whose `dateKey` is `Prior Average` and `Prior Total`. Drop those two before a trend chart. Stat cards are this versus last versus average: order count, new customer count, new customer percent, order quantity, order product sales, order discount percent, order net product, invoice count, invoiced quantity, invoices total, paid percent, pre-paid percent, invoice cost percent, invoice discount percent. Four charts, no titles. Series: orders, new customers, new customer percent, invoices; product ordered, order discounts, discount percent; product invoiced, invoice discounts, product cost; order discount percent, invoice discount percent, invoice cost percent. A product filter leaves invoice-level stats empty (invoice total, paid, pre-paid). Those fields are on `MantleSalesInvoice`, which has no product. Product quantity, product sales, cost, and discount still come from the item document. Say that when the user filters by product. For last week or last month, use `ordersLast` or `invoicesLast` with that `interval`. `ordersThis` is the period still in progress. Screen tables if a GET is useful after the services: `TopProductList`, `SalesOrderSummaryList`, `TopCustomerClassList`, `SalesInvoiceSummaryList`. # Relational reports Database views. GET `actions/{form}` on the screen. Use these when ElasticSearch is down, or when the user wants a grouped table rather than the dashboard. Sales Order Analysis `/apps/marble/Accounting/Reports/SalesAnalysis` form `SalesAnalysis`, entity `mantle.order.OrderItemSalesSummary`. Vendor role fixed `OrgInternal`. Same placed-through-hold statuses. Item types are product items (`EngItemsProduct`). Default `placedDate` this month (`placedDate_poffset=0`, `placedDate_period=month`). Filters: placed date, vendor, customer, store, product. Includes `totalSales` and `totalCost`. Sales Invoice Analysis `/SalesInvoiceAnalysis` form `SalesInvoiceAnalysis`, entity `mantle.account.invoice.InvoiceItemSalesSummary`. Same invoice statuses. Product item types. Default asset class `AsClsInventoryFin`. Filter `invoiceDate`, product, store. Order Item Summary `/OrderItemSummary` form `OrderItemSummary`, entity `mantle.order.OrderItemAndPartSummary`. Default `orderType=Sales`, statuses `OrderApproved,OrderSent,OrderCompleted`, `placedDate` previous month (`poffset=-1`). Sales sets vendor role `OrgInternal`. Purchase sets customer role `OrgInternal`. Columns include min, max, and average amount and quantity. Order Issued and Invoiced `/OrderIssuedInvoiced` form `OrderIssuedInvoiced`, entity `mantle.order.OrderItemShipBillSummary`. Default statuses `OrderApproved,OrderCompleted,OrderHold`. Compare `issuedQuantity` and `billedQuantity`. Invoice Item Summary `/InvoiceItemSummary` form `InvoiceItemSummary`, entity `mantle.account.invoice.InvoiceItemSummary`. `invoiceType` `Receivable` or `Payable`. Default statuses cover the receivable finalized set and the payable approved set. Invoice Aging Detail `/InvoiceAgingDetail` form `InvoiceAgingList`, entity `mantle.account.invoice.InvoicePaymentApplicationSummary`. `invoiceType` Receivable (statuses `InvoiceFinalized,InvoiceSent,InvoiceAcked,InvoicePmtRecvd,InvoiceWriteOff`) or Payable (`InvoiceApproved,InvoicePmtSent,InvoiceBilledThrough`). `periodDays` default `30`. Age by `invoiceDate` or `dueDate`. `asOfDate` is the end of that day. Buckets: current, then four `periodDays` spans, then older. AR Aging Summary `/ArAgingSummary` form `InvoiceAgingList` (same form name, different screen), same invoice entity plus unapplied payments (`PaymentAndApplicationSummary`). Age by due date or invoice date. Columns include unpaid and overpaid (unapplied). Quick Aging is `/apps/marble/Invoice/Aging`, not under Reports. Invoice Reconciliation `/InvoiceReconciliation` ties out one `timePeriodId`: invoice payments versus GL, payment applications versus GL, accounting transactions not posted, debits not equal to credits, GL activity with no invoice, and payment applications dated after the invoice. Use it when invoices and the ledger disagree. Customer Statement PDF (`receivableStatement` on ReportList) downloads a PDF. Fields `fromPartyId`, `toPartyId`, `asOfDate`. It is not a summary query. Link `/qapps/marble/Accounting/Reports/{name}`.

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: inventory-asset-reports
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: Inventory and asset reports
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: Inventory valuation on hand receipt asset status shipment packages
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Inventory and asset reports Read only. No sim. No confirm. Sales trends are `order-invoice-reports`. Menu `/apps/marble/Accounting/Reports/ReportList`. Three screens reuse the form name `AssetOnHandSummary`. GET the full screen path. On Hand GET `/apps/marble/Accounting/Reports/AssetOnHand/actions/AssetOnHandSummary`, entity `mantle.product.asset.AssetOnHandSummary`, detail from `AssetOnHandDetail`. Filters: product, owner, facility, location, asset, order, shipment, invoice. On Hand Summary GET `/apps/marble/Accounting/Reports/AssetOnHandSummary/actions/AssetOnHandSummary`, same summary entity, grouped. Also received date, shipment, return, issuance, receipt, physical inventory. Status by Receipt GET `/apps/marble/Accounting/Reports/AssetStatusByReceipt/actions/AssetOnHandSummary`, entity `mantle.product.asset.AssetAndDetailSummary`. Received date, owner, facility, location, product. Columns are asset statuses, not a quantity-on-hand total. Inventory Valuation `/AssetValuation` form `AssetValuationSummary`, entity `mantle.product.asset.AssetValuationSummary`. Product, facility, manufacturer. `quantityOnHandDiff` is the quantity column. Receipt Transactions `/AssetReceiptTransaction` form `AssetReceiptTxList`, entity `mantle.ledger.transaction.AcctgTransEntryReceiptSummary`. Default `transactionDate` this month and `debitCreditFlag=D`. Filters: facility, posted, transaction type, organization, other party, shipment, order, invoice, asset, product, lot, GL account. Quantity received and unit cost. Shipment Package Summary `/ShipmentPackageSummary` form `ShipmentPackageSummary`, entity `mantle.shipment.ShipmentPackageSummary`. Actual date, from or to party, origin or destination facility, product, shipment status and type, order, return, box type. Packages, not inventory valuation. Paths are under `/apps/marble/Accounting/Reports/`. Link `/qapps/marble/Accounting/Reports/{name}`.

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: ledger-accounting-reports
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: Ledger accounting reports
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: Cash flow retained earnings financial ratios account ledger posted amounts GL
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Ledger accounting reports Read only. No sim. No confirm. Income Statement, Balance Sheet, last-month invoiced totals, **Recalc All**, and a closed-period warning stay on `review-accounting-reports`. Do not POST `recalculateAllAmounts` from this skill. Financial statement screens are HTML. Do not GET them. `run_service` `mantle.ledger.LedgerReportServices` with `organizationPartyId` (internal org; `activeOrgId` when the user means this company) and `timePeriodIdList`. Find the period the same way as `review-accounting-reports`: GET `/apps/marble/Accounting/TimePeriod/FindTimePeriod/actions/TimePeriodList` `partyId`=activeOrgId `timePeriodTypeId`=`FiscalMonth` (or `FiscalQuarter` or `FiscalYear`) and use the row that covers the range. `childOrgPeriods` defaults false. Cash Flow: `run#CashFlowStatement`. Also `detail`. No percent-of-revenue flag. Retained Earnings: `run#RetainedEarningsStatement`. No `detail`. Financial Ratios: `run#FinancialRatios`. No `detail`. Charts on ReportList (revenue and expense, current assets and liabilities, net income, balance sheet, net income year over year) are the same GL totals, not separate services. Link `/qapps/marble/Accounting/Reports/ReportList`. # Transaction reports Account Ledger: `run_service` `get#AccountLedgerInfo`. Required `glAccountIdList` and one `timePeriodId`. Optional `organizationPartyId`, `showReverses` default false. Result list is `entryInfoList`. Do not GET the HTML screen. Account Balance History: GET `/apps/marble/Accounting/Reports/AccountBalance/actions/AccountBalanceHistory`, entity `mantle.ledger.report.GlAccountOrgTimePeriodSummary`. Fields `organizationPartyId`, `timePeriodTypeId` (`FiscalYear` `FiscalQuarter` `FiscalMonth`), `glAccountId`. Posted Amount Summary: `run_service` `run#PostedAmountSummary`. Required `organizationPartyId`, optional `fromDate` and `thruDate` (the screen field `dateRange`). Result `resultList` has `debitAmount` and `creditAmount` by GL account. Currency comes from the organization's accounting preference. Posted Balance Summary: GET `/apps/marble/Accounting/Reports/PostedBalanceSummary/actions/ResultList`, entity `mantle.ledger.report.GlAccountOrgTimePeriodDetail`. Fields `organizationPartyId` and one `timePeriodId`. A single transaction or entry is `/apps/marble/Accounting/Transaction` and `FindTransactionEntry`, not these summaries. Invoice versus GL is `order-invoice-reports` (Invoice Reconciliation).

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: my-open-work
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: My open work
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: Open tasks time sales orders shipments invoices requests picklists for the logged-in user and company
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # My open work Read only. No sim. No confirm. GET each Find form-list the user can browse. Skip a path browse does not show. Prefer `/apps/marble/...`. If browse returns another app's mount of the same screen, use that path (HiveMind mounts Task at `/apps/hm/Task`; do not assume Order, Shipment, or Invoice exist under `/apps/hm`). Use `partyId` and `activeOrgId` only on fields those screens actually have. Do not guess the company. Canvas: short counts, one table, and Links (`/qapps/...`). - Tasks GET `/apps/marble/Task/FindTask/actions/ListTasks` `partyId`=session partyId (Assigned To). No `activeOrgId` field. Open `statusId` `WeInPlanning,WeApproved,WeInProgress,WeOnHold` `statusId_op`=in. Link `/qapps/marble/Task/TaskSummary?workEffortId=`. - Time GET `/apps/my/User/TimeEntries/actions/TimeEntryList`. My Account already filters to the logged-in `partyId` (not a find field here). `clientPartyId`=activeOrgId (Employer). Link `/qapps/my/User/TimeEntries`. - Sales orders GET `/apps/marble/Order/FindOrder/actions/OrderList` `orderType`=Sales `partStatusId`=`OrderPlaced,OrderApproved` `partStatusId_op`=in `vendorPartyId`=activeOrgId. Find field is `partStatusId`, not `statusId`. Dashboard Placed also includes `OrderProcessing`; Approved also includes `OrderSent`. Link `/qapps/marble/Order/OrderDetail?orderId=`. - Outgoing shipments GET `/apps/marble/Shipment/FindShipment/actions/ShipmentList` `parentShipmentType`=`ShpTpOutgoing` (screen actions, not a column) `statusId`=`ShipInput,ShipScheduled,ShipPicked` `statusId_op`=in. Form field `shipmentTypeEnumId`. `fromPartyId`=activeOrgId when that field is the company. Link `/qapps/marble/Shipment/ShipmentDetail?shipmentId=`. - Receivable invoices GET `/apps/marble/Accounting/Invoice/FindInvoice/actions/InvoiceList` `invoiceType`=Receivable `fromPartyId`=activeOrgId `statusId`=`InvoiceInProcess,InvoiceFinalized,InvoiceSent,InvoiceAcked` `statusId_op`=in. Link `/qapps/marble/Accounting/Invoice/EditInvoice?invoiceId=`. - Requests GET `/apps/marble/Request/FindRequest/actions/ListRequests`. Party find field is `findPartyId` (not `partyId`). Mine: `findPartyId`=session partyId `roleTypeId`=Assignee. Dashboard customer queue: `roleTypeId`=Customer `statusId`=`ReqSubmitted` or `ReqReviewed,ReqInProgress`. Link `/qapps/marble/Request/EditRequest?requestId=`. - Picklists GET `/apps/marble/Shipping/Picklist/FindPicklist/actions/PicklistList` `partyId`=session partyId (Person) `ownerPartyId`=activeOrgId. Link `/qapps/marble/Shipping/Picklist/PicklistDetail?workEffortId=`.

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: create-supplier
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: Create supplier
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: Find or create Supplier organization on FindSupplier New Organization Supplier
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Create supplier Before this write: if the prompt lists a QuickSearch or QuickLookup actions path, GET it and create only when nothing matches. Dashboard Suppliers → `/apps/marble/Supplier/FindSupplier`. Screen sets `roleTypeId`=Supplier. GET `actions/SupplierListForm` `organizationName` or `combinedName` (extends PartyListForm). Create only when nothing matches. **New Organization Supplier** POST `createOrganization` fields: `organizationName`, hidden `roleTypeId`=Supplier. **New Person Supplier** POST `createPerson` (CreatePersonForm: `firstName`, `lastName`, same hidden `roleTypeId`). Do not post card numbers. Returns `partyId`. Link `/qapps/marble/Supplier/EditSupplier?partyId=`. EditSupplier is not EditParty. Do not use `add-party-contact-info` transitions here. Next: `create-purchase-order`.

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: create-purchase-order
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: Create purchase order
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: Create Purchase Order add product item Place Approve Order Sent on FindOrder OrderDetail
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Create purchase order Before this write: if the prompt lists a QuickSearch or QuickLookup actions path, GET it and create only when nothing matches. Dashboard Purchase Orders → `/apps/marble/Order/FindOrder` `orderType`=Purchase. The company is Customer Org, not the Vendor. `customerPartyId`=activeOrgId. `vendorPartyId`=supplier (`create-supplier`). Do not put activeOrgId in `vendorPartyId` (that mapping is the sales order only). **Create Purchase Order** POST `createOrder` fields on CreatePurchaseOrder only: `vendorPartyId`, `customerPartyId`, `facilityId`, optional `shipBeforeDate`, `estimatedDeliveryDate`. No `productStoreId` (that field is CreateSalesOrder). Starts `OrderOpen`. OrderDetail **Add Product Item** POST `addProductItem` (`orderId`, `orderPartSeqId`, `productId`, `quantity`; leave `unitAmount` empty for Calc Price). Purchase shows `standardCost` and `itemTypeEnumId` default `ItemInventory`. **Place** / **Place Warnings** POST `placeOrder` → `OrderPlaced`. **Approve** / **Approve Warnings** POST `approveOrder` → `OrderApproved` (needs ORDER_APPROVE). **Order Sent** POST `sendOrder` → `OrderSent` (button only when the customer is an internal org). Link `/qapps/marble/Order/OrderDetail?orderId=`. Next: `receive-incoming-shipment`.

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: receive-incoming-shipment
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: Receive incoming shipment
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: Create purchase shipment Receive Entire or Receive Product then Delivered payable invoice
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Receive incoming shipment Before this write: if the prompt lists a QuickSearch or QuickLookup actions path, GET it and create only when nothing matches. Do not use `receive-inventory-direct` first. Do not call listAssets. Incoming has no Set Packed (`packShipment` is outgoing only). From the purchase order (`OrderApproved` or `OrderSent`, quantity not shipped): OrderDetail **Create Shipment** POST `shipOrderPart` `orderId`, `orderPartSeqId`. That shipment is `ShpTpPurchase` (parent `ShpTpIncoming`). Or find GET `/apps/marble/Shipment/FindShipment/actions/ShipmentList` `parentShipmentType`=`ShpTpIncoming`. **New Incoming Shipment** POST `createShipment` fields: `shipmentTypeEnumId` (incoming type), `fromPartyId` (supplier), `destinationFacilityId`, `estimatedArrivalDate`. Prefer `shipOrderPart` when a PO exists. ShipmentDetail `/apps/marble/Shipment/ShipmentDetail?shipmentId=`. `ShipInput`: **Set Scheduled** POST `scheduleShipment` → `ShipScheduled`. Receive inventory: **Receive Entire Shipment** POST `receiveEntireShipment` `shipmentId` (shown for incoming `ShipScheduled`, `ShipPacked`, or `ShipShipped`). Receives remaining quantity and sets `ShipDelivered`. Delivered creates the payable invoice. One product: **Receive Product** POST `/apps/marble/Shipment/ShipmentDetail/ReceiveItem/receive` (form ReceiveForm) `shipmentId`, `productId`, `statusId`=`AstAvailable`, `quantityAccepted`, `ownerPartyId` (activeOrgId when the order did not set an owner), `acquireCost`. Then **Set Delivered** POST `deliverShipment` `shipmentId`, `actualArrivalDate` (form SetDeliveredForm). Do not use UpdateItemAsset `updateAsset` to receive; that updates an existing asset. Link `/qapps/marble/Shipment/ShipmentDetail?shipmentId=`. Next: `approve-payable-invoice`.

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: approve-payable-invoice
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: Approve payable invoice
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: Payable invoice Receive then Approve InvoiceApproved on EditInvoice status flow
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Approve payable invoice Before this write: if the prompt lists a QuickSearch or QuickLookup actions path, GET it and create only when nothing matches. Find `/apps/marble/Accounting/Invoice/FindInvoice` `invoiceType`=Payable `toPartyId`=activeOrgId (To Organization). From is the supplier. Purchase shipment Delivered creates this invoice. A payable from a non-internal From party starts `InvoiceIncoming`. EditInvoice `/apps/marble/Accounting/Invoice/EditInvoice?invoiceId=`. Status buttons are the InvoicePayable flow POST `updateStatus` with `invoiceId` and `statusId` (not a separate approve transition). `InvoiceIncoming` **Receive** → `InvoiceReceived`, or **Approve** → `InvoiceApproved` (needs INVOICE_APPROVE). `InvoiceReceived` **Approve** → `InvoiceApproved` (GL posts). **Acknowledged** → `InvoiceAcked` is optional. Do not post `InvoiceFinalized` on a payable (that is the receivable flow). **Payment Sent** (`InvoicePmtSent`) is a status only. To pay, use `pay-supplier`. Before Approve, read `messages` on the tool result. If a message says the period is closed, repeat that warning in the confirm sentence. Link `/qapps/marble/Accounting/Invoice/EditInvoice?invoiceId=`.

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: pay-supplier
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: Pay supplier
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: Outgoing PtInvoicePayment From internal org To supplier for a payable invoice
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Pay supplier Before this write: if the prompt lists a QuickSearch or QuickLookup actions path, GET it and create only when nothing matches. The paying company is activeOrgId. Do not guess another company. Do not post card numbers. Confirm text must name amount, supplier, and invoiceId before the write. Find the payable `/apps/marble/Accounting/Invoice/FindInvoice` `invoiceType`=Payable `statusId`=`InvoiceApproved` `toPartyId`=activeOrgId. Supplier is the invoice From party. Same call as `receive-invoice-payment`, outgoing: EditInvoice **New Payment for Invoice** POST `recordPayment` fields: `invoiceId`, `amount`, `statusId` (`PmntPromised` default; `PmntDelivered` if already sent), `effectiveDate`, `paymentInstrumentEnumId`. The service sets payment From=invoice To (activeOrgId), To=invoice From (supplier), type `PtInvoicePayment`. Do not send a different `toPartyId`. `PmntDelivered` applies the payment; unpaid 0 on an approved invoice sets `InvoicePmtSent`. Find outgoing payments GET `/apps/marble/Accounting/Payment/FindPayment/actions/PaymentList` `paymentType`=Outgoing `paymentTypeEnumId`=`PtInvoicePayment` `fromPartyId`=activeOrgId. **New Outgoing Payment** has no `invoiceId`. POST `createPayment` `fromPartyId`=activeOrgId, `toPartyId`=supplier, `amount`, `paymentTypeEnumId`=`PtInvoicePayment`, `effectiveDate` (starts `PmntPromised`). Then EditPayment **Deliver** POST `updateStatus` `statusId`=`PmntDelivered`, then form UnpaidInvoiceList POST `applyInvoicePayment` `paymentId`, `invoiceId`, `amount` (only when Delivered). Before the payment, read `messages`. If a message says the period is closed, repeat that warning in the confirm sentence. Link `/qapps/marble/Accounting/Payment/EditPayment?paymentId=` and `/qapps/marble/Accounting/Invoice/EditInvoice?invoiceId=`.

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: create-customer-request
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: Create customer request
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: Create or update customer Request on FindRequest and EditRequest status flow
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Customer request Before this write: if the prompt lists a QuickSearch or QuickLookup actions path, GET it and create only when nothing matches. Dashboard Customer Requests → `/apps/marble/Request/FindRequest` (Request defaults to FindRequest). GET `actions/ListRequests` before create. Party filter is `findPartyId`, not `partyId`. **New Request** POST `createRequest` fields: `customerPartyId`, optional `productStoreId`, `rootWorkEffortId`, `facilityId`, `assignToPartyId` (empty assigns the current user), `priority`, `responseRequiredDate`, `requestTypeEnumId` (default `RqtSupport`), `statusId` (default `ReqSubmitted`), `requestName`, `description`. EditRequest POST `updateRequest` updates name, description, `assignToPartyId`, `priority`, `responseRequiredDate`, `requestTypeEnumId`, `requestResolutionEnumId`. It has no status field. Status only by EditRequest status-flow POST `updateStatus` `requestId` and `statusId`: **Submit** `ReqSubmitted`, **Reviewed** `ReqReviewed`, **Start Progress** `ReqInProgress`, **Complete** `ReqCompleted`, **Cancel** `ReqCancelled`, **Re-open** back to `ReqInProgress`. Use only the button the current status shows. Link `/qapps/marble/Request/EditRequest?requestId=`.

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: create-sales-quote
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: Create sales quote
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: Sales order createOrder then Quote Requested or Propose Quote on OrderDetail
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Sales quote Before this write: if the prompt lists a QuickSearch or QuickLookup actions path, GET it and create only when nothing matches. There is no separate quote screen. A quote is a sales order left in `OrderRequested` or `OrderProposed`. Dashboard Sales Orders and Quotes → `/apps/marble/Order/FindOrder` `orderType`=Sales. Vendor is the company: `vendorPartyId`=activeOrgId. Do not guess another company. **Create Sales Order** POST `createOrder`: `productStoreId`, `vendorPartyId`, `facilityId`, `customerPartyId`. Starts `OrderOpen`. OrderDetail **Add Product Item** POST `addProductItem` (`productId`, `quantity`; leave `unitAmount` empty for Calc Price). `OrderOpen`: **Quote Requested** POST `requestOrder` → `OrderRequested`. `OrderOpen` or `OrderRequested`: **Propose Quote** POST `proposeOrder` → `OrderProposed`. `OrderRequested`: **Reject Quote Request** POST `rejectOrder` → `OrderRejected`. Do not POST `placeOrder` unless the user wants a placed order (`create-sales-order`). Link `/qapps/marble/Order/OrderDetail?orderId=`.

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: process-sales-return
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: Process sales return
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: Customer return RMA shipment ShpTpSalesReturn credit memo refund; supplier return is the same screens
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Sales return Before this write: if the prompt lists a QuickSearch or QuickLookup actions path, GET it and create only when nothing matches. Vendor on a customer return is the company: `vendorPartyId`=activeOrgId. Do not post card numbers. Find GET `/apps/marble/Return/FindReturn/actions/ReturnHeaderList` `returnType`=Customer. **Create Customer Return** POST `createReturn` (form CreateReturn): `customerPartyId`, `vendorPartyId`=activeOrgId, `facilityId`. Or OrderDetail **Create Return** POST `createReturnFromOrder` `orderId`, `orderPartSeqId`. EditReturn: **Set Requested** POST `requestReturn` (`ReturnCreated` → `ReturnRequested`). **Approve** POST `approveReturn` (`ReturnApproved`). **Cancel** POST `cancelReturn`. Add lines `/apps/marble/Return/AddOrderItems` form AddOrderItemToReturn POST `addOrderItemToReturn`: `returnId`, `orderId`, `orderItemSeqId`, `returnQuantity` or `responseAmount`, `returnReasonEnumId`, `returnResponseEnumId`, `responseImmediate` (`N` on received, `Y` on approved). Response enum: `RrspCredit` Credit, `RrspRefund` Refund, `RrspReplace` Replace, `RrspManual` Manual. Set it with EditReturnItems form ReturnItemList POST `updateReturnItem`. **Create Return Shipment** POST `createReturnShipment` `returnId`. Customer return shipment is `ShpTpSalesReturn` (incoming). Find `/apps/marble/Shipment/FindShipment` `shipmentTypeEnumId`=`ShpTpSalesReturn`. Receive that shipment with `receive-incoming-shipment` (`receiveEntireShipment` or ReceiveItem `receive`), not `receive-inventory-direct`. **Process Item Responses** POST `processReturnItemResponses`. Credit becomes a credit memo; Refund becomes payment type `PtRefund`. **Receive without Shipment** POST `receiveReturnWithoutShipment` only if the user wants no shipment. Find credit memos `/apps/marble/Accounting/Invoice/FindInvoice` `invoiceType`=Payable `invoiceTypeEnumId`=`InvoiceCreditMemo`. Return invoices: `invoiceType`=Payable `invoiceTypeEnumId`=`InvoiceReturn`. Manual credit on an unpaid invoice: EditInvoice **New Credit Memo** POST `createCreditMemo` `originalInvoiceId`, `amount`, `description`, `itemTypeEnumId`, `invoiceDate`. Or FindInvoice **Customer Credit Memo** POST `createInvoice` with `invoiceTypeEnumId`=`InvoiceCreditMemo` (From customer, To activeOrgId). Refund already taken on a Delivered payment: EditPayment **Create Refund** POST `createRefundPayment` `paymentId`, `amount`, `statusId` (default `PmntPromised`). Find `/apps/marble/Accounting/Payment/FindPayment` `paymentType`=Outgoing `paymentTypeEnumId`=`PtRefund`. # Purchase return Same screens. **Create Supplier Return** POST `createReturn` (form CreateSupplierReturn): `vendorPartyId`=supplier, `customerPartyId`=activeOrgId, `facilityId`. Find `returnType`=Supplier. Shipment is `ShpTpPurchaseReturn` (outgoing, not an incoming receive). Do not POST `receiveEntireShipment` on it. Pack and ship with `packShipment` / `shipShipment` only if those outgoing buttons are on the shipment. Return invoice find: `invoiceType`=Receivable `invoiceTypeEnumId`=`InvoiceReturn`. Refund find: `paymentType`=Incoming `paymentTypeEnumId`=`PtRefund`. Link `/qapps/marble/Return/EditReturn?returnId=`.

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: update-work-task
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: Update work task
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: Update task status assignee and due date on TaskSummary EditTask EditUsers FindTask
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Update work task Before this write: if the prompt lists a QuickSearch or QuickLookup actions path, GET it and create only when nothing matches. Find GET `/apps/marble/Task/FindTask/actions/ListTasks`. Link `/qapps/marble/Task/TaskSummary?workEffortId=`. Status: TaskSummary POST `updateTaskStatus` `workEffortId`, `statusId`. Load allowed values with `getTaskStatuses` (flow from the current status only). EditTask POST `updateTask` has the same flow-limited `statusId` dropdown. Do not post a status the control does not offer. WorkEffort statuses: `WeInPlanning` `WeApproved` `WeInProgress` `WeOnHold` `WeComplete` `WeClosed` `WeCancelled`. Due date is `estimatedCompletionDate` (yyyy-MM-dd). TaskSummary shows it and has no due-date transition. POST EditTask `updateTask`, or FindTask selected **Update** form UpdateTaskSelected POST `updateTask` (also `statusId`, `priority`). Assignee is not a field on TaskSummary or EditTask. Task/EditUsers **Add Person** POST `addAssignment` `workEffortId`, `partyId`, `roleTypeId`=`Assignee`, `statusId`=`WeptAssigned` (WorkEffortParty default on that form). FindTask **Assign** POST `addWorkEffortParty` with the same party fields.

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: add-record-note
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: Add a note
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: Add note on party or order, or a comment on a task or request
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Add a note Before this write: if the prompt lists a QuickSearch or QuickLookup actions path, GET it and create only when nothing matches. Party: EditParty **Add Note** POST `createPartyNote` `partyId`, `noteText`. Link `/qapps/marble/Party/EditParty?partyId=`. Order: OrderDetail **Add Note** POST `createNote` `orderId`, `noteText`. Link `/qapps/marble/Order/OrderDetail?orderId=`. Task has no note transition. TaskSummary **Add Comment** POST `addComment` `workEffortId`, `subject`, `body`. Link `/qapps/marble/Task/TaskSummary?workEffortId=`. Request also has a note: EditRequest **Add Note** POST `createNote` `requestId`, `noteText`, and **Add Comment** POST `addComment` `requestId`, `subject`, `body`. Shipment screens have no note or comment transition; do not invent one.

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: create-party
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: Create party
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: Pick the skill for a sales account, sales contact, person or retail customer, employee, supplier, or internal organization
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Create party Before this write: if the prompt lists a QuickSearch or QuickLookup actions path, GET it and create only when nothing matches. Do not POST a customer, employee, supplier, or internal organization from this skill. Classify the party, then `find_skill` `select` the matching name and follow that skill. - Company / internal organization: `create-internal-organization` - Business or organization customer, sales account: `create-sales-account` - Person at a sales account (billing or other account-contact role): `add-sales-contact` - Retail, consumer, or other person customer: `create-person-customer` - Employee: `create-employee` - Supplier (organization or person): `create-supplier` Only when none of those fit and the user already named another role: `/apps/marble/Party/FindParty` **New Person** POST `createPerson` (`firstName`, `lastName`, hidden `roleTypeId`) or **New Organization** POST `createOrganization` (`organizationName`, hidden `roleTypeId`). Use the `roleTypeId` already on that find. Do not use this fallback for a customer, employee, supplier, or internal organization.

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: marble-party-roles
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: Marble party roles and concepts
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: Party Person Organization roles OrgInternal Customer Account Supplier Employee invoice From To
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Party roles Create a party with `create-party`. Party = Person or Organization. Direct roles (`RgpDirect`): - Person customer: role `Customer`, class `CustConsumer` (retail/consumer) or another customer class - `OrgInternal` your company - `Customer` + `Account` Sales Account (org customer) - Sales Contact: `PrtContact`; roles `RgpAccountContact` e.g. `ClientBilling` - `Supplier`, `Employee` (employment class is separate) Order: Vendor vs Customer. Invoice: From vs To. Receivable From=`OrgInternal`; Payable To=`OrgInternal`. Find: `/apps/marble/Party/FindParty` with `roleTypeId`.

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: marble-order-shipment-status
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: Order and shipment statuses
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: OrderOpen OrderPlaced OrderApproved shipment ShipPacked ShipShipped outgoing invoice
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Order status (`OrderHeader`) `OrderOpen` Open (Tentative) → `OrderPlaced` (Customer) → `OrderApproved` (Vendor) → `OrderCompleted`. Also: `OrderRequested`/`OrderProposed` quotes; `OrderHold`; `OrderCancelled`/`OrderRejected`; `OrderSent` (PO). Sales: Vendor=Internal Org. Screens: `/apps/marble/Order/FindOrder` `orderType=Sales`. # Shipment `ShipInput` `ShipScheduled` `ShipPicked` `ShipPacked` `ShipShipped` `ShipDelivered` (`ShipCancelled`/`ShipRejected`). Outgoing: Packed required; Packed creates receivable invoice. Incoming: Delivered receives and may create payable invoice.

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: marble-invoice-payment-status
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: Invoice and payment statuses
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: InvoiceInProcess InvoiceFinalized InvoicePmtRecvd PmntPromised PmntDelivered payable receivable
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # Receivable invoice `InvoiceInProcess` → **Finalize** `InvoiceFinalized` (GL post, immutable) → optional Sent/Acked → `InvoicePmtRecvd`. # Payable `InvoiceIncoming` → `InvoiceReceived` → **Approve** `InvoiceApproved` (GL) → `InvoicePmtSent`. Find `/apps/marble/Accounting/Invoice/FindInvoice` `invoiceType=Receivable|Payable`. # Payment `PmntProposed` `PmntPromised` `PmntAuthorized` `PmntDelivered` `PmntConfirmed`; fail: Cancelled/Void/Declined. Incoming To=Internal Org. Apply Payment or credit memo (reversed From/To) to settle invoice.

moqui.llm.LlmSkill.name: marble-product-asset-types
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.title: Product asset and work types
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.description: PtAsset PtService AstTpInventory AsClsInventoryFin AstAvailable WetProject WetTask WeInProgress
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.speaker: human
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.warrant: Marble ERP User Guide: Initial Setup and Basics
moqui.llm.LlmSkill.body: # ProductType `PtAsset` Asset (Good), `PtService`, `PtDigital`, `PtDigitalAsset`, `PtAssetUse`, `PtFacilityUse`, `PtVirtual`, `PtPickAssembly`, `PtConfigurable`. # Asset Type / Class (on Product) Inventory: `AstTpInventory` + `AsClsInventoryFin` (Finished Good). Also Raw `AsClsInventoryRaw`, Sub `AsClsInventorySub`. # Asset status — only `AstAvailable` may be reserved/issued/sold. Also Incoming, On Hold, Returned, Promised, Delivered, In Transfer, Defective, Quarantine, Morgue. # WorkEffort Type `WetProject`/`WetTask`. Status `WeInPlanning` `WeApproved` `WeInProgress` `WeOnHold` `WeComplete` `WeClosed` `WeCancelled`. Screens: `/apps/marble/Catalog/Product/FindProduct`, `/apps/marble/Asset/Asset/FindSummary`, `/apps/marble/Project/FindProject`.
